page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head and page number above it. Margin text on the right edge belongs to the facing page and is left out.

main_text.p: etiam in Latinis, si alicubi restarent indigenæ, si non tempestiv[?] totos se abscondissent in libris Hæc pro Belgio; At intentatum ictum retundit hoc umbone La-tium: Egregiam verò laudem ć[?] Belgica: Quid hoc, quo ita tur-ges, est aliud, quàm cæteris idio-matibus ancillari? Nam quemad-modum Ludiones & Pyrrhicha-rii, plumbum circumferunt in fo-leis, quo pes ab onere solutus in Scena, cum levi socco saltet agi-lius: Ita Belgica lingua gentiles suos asperè habet: Duriuscula est & barbarizat: Vox utplurimum non nisi syllba: Et in unam sylla-bam, integrum aliquando plau-strum exonerat Aspirationum & Consonantum: Hinc dum Belgæ nitidis exterorum ac fa-cilibus se addicunt linguis, vel manumissi à rigida pædagoga, lu-xuriant,

page.notes: The word "tempestiv" at the line end is cut off and is probably "tempestivi" or similar; read with [?]. The character after "laudem" ("ć") is doubtful. Some letters at the left edge of the lines are faint. The right edge carries the facing page's margin, which is not transcribed.
